mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level: 2.01%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active, so no threshold condition is required.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of all instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, compressing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of federal funds rate below 2.5% and unemployment rate above 5.5% signals insufficient monetary policy easing to prevent labor market deterioration, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annual inflation), Federal Reserve tightening compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (annual inflation), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, compressing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of industrial production below 100 and housing starts below 1000 signals deepening economic contraction, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market downturns (HOUST < 1000), declining residential construction compresses consumer wealth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active, so no threshold condition is required.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of all instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
